diagnostic.summary: On TRAIN, btc-trend-24-72-demo generates a gross_return of 0.2777 across turnover of 177, which is heavily eroded by fees (0.2056) and slippage (0.02056) to a net_return of 0.05147 (90% CI [-0.3803, 0.8327], Sharpe 0.2918) (ev_cost_attribu_2ffdab43b2). Across all 9 regime buckets in ev_regime_perfo_dd9863f9c8, every 90% confidence interval spans zero, so all regime findings are weak. Point estimates are highest in sentiment_regime=greed (mean_net_return 3.871e-05, n_trades=38) and liquidity_regime=thin (1.960e-05, n_trades=48), and negative in trend_regime=sideways (-3.544e-05, n_trades=19, fragile due to <20 trades) and sentiment_regime=fear (-1.690e-05, n_trades=51).

hypotheses.statement: The strategy performs relatively better in sentiment_regime=greed (mean_net_return 3.871e-05 across 38 trades, 90% CI [-3.803e-05, 0.0001204]) than in sentiment_regime=fear (mean_net_return -1.690e-05 across 51 trades, 90% CI [-8.785e-05, 5.498e-05]), though both CIs span zero. Falsified if out-of-sample mean_net_return in sentiment_regime=greed is <= sentiment_regime=fear or <= 0.
caveats: The 90% confidence interval in both buckets spans zero (greed: [-3.803e-05, 0.0001204]; fear: [-8.785e-05, 5.498e-05]), making this evidence weak.
9 regime buckets were scanned without multiple-comparison correction.
hypotheses.suggested_test: Compare mean_net_return between sentiment_regime=greed and sentiment_regime=fear on out-of-sample validation data; falsified if greed return is non-positive or lower than fear return.

hypotheses.statement: The strategy works worse in trend_regime=sideways (mean_net_return -3.544e-05, 90% CI [-0.0001147, 3.459e-05], n_trades=19) than in trend_regime=bull (1.398e-05, 90% CI [-0.0001040, 0.0001434], n_trades=70), while fees (0.2056) and slippage (0.02056) cut gross_return (0.2777) to net_return 0.05147. Falsified if sideways mean_net_return > 0 out-of-sample.
caveats: The 90% confidence intervals span zero in all regimes, and trend_regime=sideways has only 19 trades (< 20 trades threshold) while trend_regime=bear has 0 trades.
High transaction costs (fees 0.2056 and slippage 0.02056 vs gross_return 0.2777) erode net performance across all regimes.
hypotheses.suggested_test: Evaluate mean_net_return in trend_regime=sideways vs trend_regime=bull on validation data; falsified if trend_regime=sideways achieves positive net return or outperforms trend_regime=bull.

hypotheses.statement: The strategy exhibits higher point-estimate return in liquidity_regime=thin (mean_net_return 1.960e-05, hit_rate 0.5080, n_trades=48, 90% CI [-4.796e-05, 8.982e-05]) than in liquidity_regime=deep (mean_net_return 1.463e-06, hit_rate 0.4987, n_trades=41, 90% CI [-8.390e-05, 9.101e-05]). Falsified if out-of-sample mean_net_return in liquidity_regime=thin is <= liquidity_regime=deep or <= 0.
caveats: Both 90% confidence intervals span zero (thin: [-4.796e-05, 8.982e-05]; deep: [-8.390e-05, 9.101e-05]), so statistical support is weak.
hypotheses.suggested_test: Test whether mean_net_return in liquidity_regime=thin exceeds liquidity_regime=deep and zero on out-of-sample validation data.

rejected_explanations: Strong outperformance in trend_regime=bear (mean_net_return 5.305e-05, hit_rate 0.5593): rejected as a reliable trading regime because n_trades=0 (only existing positions carried or no new trades executed, < 20 trades threshold) and its 90% CI [-2.244e-05, 0.0001253] spans zero.

Statistically significant volatility regime edge between vol_regime=low (mean_net_return 1.481e-05, n_trades=45, 90% CI [-4.954e-05, 8.332e-05]) and vol_regime=high (mean_net_return 6.247e-06, n_trades=44, 90% CI [-7.907e-05, 9.163e-05]): rejected because both 90% confidence intervals heavily overlap and span zero.
limitations: Every single one of the 9 scanned regime buckets in ev_regime_perfo_dd9863f9c8 has a 90% confidence interval spanning zero, and the overall strategy net_return of 0.05147 has a 90% CI of [-0.3803, 0.8327], meaning no regime exhibits statistically significant edge on TRAIN.
Two trend buckets have fewer than 20 trades (trend_regime=bear has n_trades=0 and trend_regime=sideways has n_trades=19), making their estimates fragile.
Validation and test splits are unavailable, preventing out-of-sample verification.

proposals.rationale: Based on H1, the strategy performs better in greed (mean_net_return 3.871e-05) than fear (-1.690e-05). Gating with fear_greed > 53 (train median) sets allocation to 0.0 in lower sentiment, raising train net_return from 0.05147 to 0.1636, Sharpe from 0.2918 to 0.6740, and cutting turnover from 177 to 102.
proposals.falsification_test: Falsified on validation if net_return <= always_on net_return or if Sharpe does not improve over always_on.

overfit_risks: Unstationary feature threshold: fear_greed > 53 was the 0.50 quantile on train (allocation 1.0 on 54.67% of bars in ev_test_gate_tr_76dd66e2f3), but due to sentiment regime shift in validation (ev_arbiter_eval_9275ad07ad), fear_greed rarely exceeds 53 (0.8485% of bars).

Five gate trials were evaluated on train across multiple features and hypotheses; even for this selected gate, the train 90% ci_delta [-0.3799, 0.4615] and validation 90% ci_delta [-0.2600, 0.2828] both span zero widely.
fragile_samples: Degenerate allocation mix and fragile sample size on validation (ev_arbiter_eval_9275ad07ad): the gate is off (allocation 0.0) 99.15% of the time and on (allocation 1.0) only 0.8485% of the time, resulting in exposure of 0.004035 and only n_switches = 2 (turnover = 2).
counterexamples: On validation (ev_arbiter_eval_9275ad07ad), the proposal fails its own falsification test: Sharpe worsens from -0.4636 (always_on) to -0.9612, and net_return remains negative (-0.003826).

When the gate actually activates on validation (0.8485% of bars, exposure 0.004035), it loses money (net_return -0.003826 across n_switches = 2). The positive delta_net_return_vs_always_on (0.06762) is purely due to sitting out 99.15% of a losing validation period (always_on net_return -0.07145).
observations: In ev_regime_perfo_dd9863f9c8, 9 regime buckets were scanned without multiple-comparison correction, and both sentiment_regime 90% CIs span zero (greed: [-3.803e-05, 0.0001204], fear: [-8.785e-05, 5.498e-05]).

limitations: 5 distinct agent gate specs attempted (5 agent train tests logged, refused ones included); 7 distinct policies evaluated in total. Multiple-comparison risk applies to train and validation results.
The critic can veto a proposal (part of the pre-registered rule); the critic sees validation results.
Regime effects are associations under lagged features, not causal.
Returns convention: compounded simple returns after costs everywhere (Lane A contract); deltas and CIs use the same convention.
The verdict only says whether an agent gate earned one sealed look; Lane A's arbiter makes the strategy decision.
LightGBM competitor: single seed (7); its result can vary with the seed. Calibrated on late train instead of validation (spec deviation, keeps validation out-of-sample).
